rdfs:label: educationLevel
rdfs:comment: The general education level the resource targets — primary, secondary, undergraduate, professional, etc.
notes: Used in educational-resources metadata to declare what level of learner the resource is suitable for. Value is typically a controlled-vocabulary term (e.g. from a `schema:DefinedTerm` set) or a free-form string when no controlled vocab applies. Sub-property of dcterms:audience (range dcterms:AgentClass) — not urn:solid:audience, which is ActivityStreams addressing.

history.note: seeAlso now points to dcterms:audience instead of AS2 audience; noted sub-property relation.
